title: NEST: Stale-Robust Tokenized-Stock Measurement for a Crypto-Treasury LETF Stack
abstract: arXiv:2610.21491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tokenized equities trade while listed markets are closed, so their marks could improve off-hours measurement along layered exposures that link Bitcoin, crypto-treasury stocks, and leveraged ETFs. A token return and the next opening gap, however, share the price move from the previous close to the token mark, so part of their apparent fit is mechanical. We develop NEST, a stale-robust protocol that separates this shared-history fit from conditional measurement value. A shared-history identity and a variance-clock bound show how much fit timing alone can generate. The partial determination index (PDI), the squared partial correlation between token and gap given public controls, measures what remains, and a finite-sample frontier expresses the partial-F decision in PDI units. translated_title: NEST：面向加密财库LETF堆栈的抗陈旧代币化股票度量协议
translated_abstract: 代币化股票在证券交易所闭市期间仍可交易，因此其标记价格可以改善连接比特币、加密财库股票和杠杆ETF的多层敞口在盘外时段的度量。然而，代币收益率与次日的开盘缺口共享从前收盘到代币标记的价格变动，因此二者表面上的拟合有一部分是机械性的。我们开发了NEST，一个抗陈旧协议，用于将这种共享历史的拟合与条件度量价值区分开来。一个共享历史恒等式和一个方差时钟界限显示了仅凭时间安排本身能产生多少拟合。部分决定指数（PDI）——即在给定公开控制变量条件下代币与缺口之间的偏相关平方——度量了剩余的真实价值，而一个有限样本边界以PDI为单位表达了偏F检验的决策规则。产品、来源、时间戳和执行审计决定一个有信息量的标记是否可被采纳。对于MSTRx——基于MicroStrategy（MSTR）的追踪凭证，一个代币……（摘要截断）
tldr: 论文提出NEST协议，利用共享历史恒等式、方差时钟界限、部分决定指数（PDI）及多重审计，将代币化股票标记对次日开盘缺口的机械性拟合与真实条件度量价值分离，从而稳健评估其对加密财库LETF链路盘外度量的增量价值。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces NEST, a stale-robust protocol that uses a shared-history identity, a variance-clock bound, the partial determination index (PDI), and multi-layer audits to separate mechanical shared-history fit from genuine conditional measurement value when using tokenized stock marks to improve off-hours measurement of crypto-treasury LETF exposures.
